title: How is Napoleon connected to Pikachu?
description:
France's line of rulers, a state dinner at Versailles and a royal visit to Wrexham connect Napoleon to Pikachu.

Napoleon → Emmanuel Macron → Charles III → Ryan Reynolds → Pikachu

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Napoleon → Emmanuel Macron (10 portraits, every holder): In 1804, Napoleon crowned himself emperor, and France's line of rulers runs from him to Emmanuel Macron.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jacques-Louis_David_-_The_Emperor_Napoleon_in_His_Study_at_the_Tuileries_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:G%C3%A9rard_-_Louis_XVIII_of_France_in_Coronation_Robes.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1841_portrait_painting_of_Louis_Philippe_I_(King_of_the_French)_by_Winterhalter.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alexandre_Cabanel_002.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adolphe_Thiers_Nadar_2.JPG + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raymond_Poincar%C3%A9_officiel_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:De_Gaulle-OWI_(cropped)_(c)(2).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Fran%C3%A7ois_Mitterrand_in_1983_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jacques_Chirac_(1997)_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emmanuel_Macron_2025_(cropped).jpg
2. Emmanuel Macron → King Charles: In 2023, Macron hosted King Charles the Third at a state dinner in the Palace of Versailles.
   Photo by UK in France, OGL 3: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:King_Charles_III_and_Emmanuel_Macron_State_Dinner_2023.jpg
3. King Charles → Ryan Reynolds: In 2022, Ryan Reynolds showed the King around Wrexham, the Welsh football club he co-owns.
   Photo by Oli Scarff/AFP via Getty Images, Fair use (commentary): https://www.etonline.com/ryan-reynolds-meets-king-charles-iii-and-camilla-at-wrexham-soccer-club-with-rob-mcelhenney-195752
4. Ryan Reynolds → Pikachu: And in 2019, Reynolds became the voice of Pikachu in the movie Detective Pikachu.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore, Legendary Pictures / Warner Bros. (via IMP Awards), CC BY-SA 3.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ryan_Reynolds_by_Gage_Skidmore_3.jpg + http://www.impawards.com/2019/pokemon_detective_pikachu_ver4.html

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#napoleon #pikachu #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
